Responsibilities of the Candidate:

Identify and generate new business leads across target industries and sectors.
Conduct client outreach through cold calls, emails, and field visits to pitch Glocert's certification services, including ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
Coordinate with technical and audit teams to align client requirements with service offerings.
Follow up on leads throughout the sales funnel from initial contact to closure.

Requirements:

MBA/BBA or candidates with a background in sales or business development are preferred.
Prior experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or client acquisition is an advantage. Freshers are welcome to apply.
Strong communication, negotiation, and pitching skills.
